description: RoarUI is a Blazor component library for .NET 10 built on WebAwesome, with strongly typed C# APIs, flexible string values, custom theming, and Blazor form validation. Supports Interactive Server and standalone WebAssembly.
releaseNotes: Includes toast, time input, tag input, stepper, and resize observer components, plus updated nullable annotations, installation documentation, and licensing information.
title: RoarUI
